summary: In this tutorial, you learn about various view options in LibreOffice Impress for creating and editing presentations. The default view is Normal View, which displays the entire presentation. You can switch to Outline View to see slides as a structured list, making it easier to organize content. The Master Pages section allows you to customize slide designs. You can change the design by selecting different layouts from the Master Pages. Slide Sorter view helps rearrange slides in a specific order. Notes view lets you add notes for each slide, which can be useful during the presentation. The Layout section in the Tasks Pane allows you to change the layout of individual slides. The tutorial concludes with an example of creating a presentation with a dark blue background and light blue title area, and suggests watching a linked video for more details on using view options and master pages effectively.
